verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs explicitly promise global AI inference via a single API call with no GPU/capacity management (cloudflare-docs-3), matching the story closely. However, this is vendor-only messaging with no independent/community evidence validating the AI inference product specifically, and some community commentary raises general skepticism about Cloudflare's newer AI-related docs being low-quality or 'AI slop' (cloudflare-comm-6), reducing confidence in real-world delivery.
